name: threadInterrupted
description: Returns true if the current thread has been interrupted, and clears the interrupted flag. Must be called from inside a ColdFusion thread; otherwise it throws an error.

coldfusion.notes: Listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2025+. No official documentation exists. Signature and behavior confirmed on CF2025.

examples.title: Stop a loop when interrupted
examples.description: Checks the flag on each pass so the thread can stop cleanly. The pause gives the thread time to start; a thread interrupted before it starts ends with status TERMINATED.
